name: Kiriya Masaki
source: An art teacher who joins Sakura Junior High School in January. His hobby is painting self-portraits, and he rarely shows up to the staff room, often holed up in the art room instead drawing pictures. He respects the Austrian painter [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Egon_Schiele]Egon Schiele[/url], and has been influenced by his painting style and upbringing. He is eerie and mysterious, in both words and behavior, and is acquainted with [url=/c136071]Nakajima Hikaru[/url].
